Container.Name: DroneUnitManager-Staging
Container.Overview: Staging instance of Drone Unit Manager, tracking the :main channel. Every merge to main lands here, so changes can be exercised against a copy of real data before a release is cut and production moves. Runs on its own port and its own appdata directory; it shares nothing with the production container. If its appdata was seeded from production, clear the SMTP credentials and the Skydio token before first start, or this instance will email real recipients and sync the real Skydio account on a schedule. See docs/staging.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the staging web interface. Must differ from the production container's.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Staging data directory. Must be a different path from the production container's, or the two will fight over the same database.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the application (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles)

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: JWT signing secret. Leave blank to auto-generate, so staging sessions are independent of production's.
